limits.countRules: URL and identity counts are raw-text occurrences, not distinct values. Identity means email, GUID or SharePoint hostname occurrence; identifiers are not automatically secrets. Credential counts use signed-query, private-key, AWS/GitHub-token and quoted credential-assignment patterns, with supported recursive inspection.
limits.historicalClaims: Bounded content classifications, not authenticated approvals. Ordinary normative documents are not credential findings merely because they discuss authentication or approval.
limits.adoption: Unchanged-candidate means eligible for narrow recovery, not automatic adoption or transitive-reference clearance.
limits.inspection: Offline bounded inspection, not exhaustive clearance; arbitrary encodings, unsupported containers, comprehensive history and exhaustive narrative review excluded.
limits.outputLocation: docs/folio-followup-candidates.json; value-free assessment results, not recovered payloads.
